details: BlackRock has filed a Form 8-A for its proposed iShares Bitcoin Premium Income ETF, signaling an imminent launch, possibly as early as next week. This new ETF aims to provide spot Bitcoin exposure along with a yield-generating mechanism by actively selling call options on its existing spot Bitcoin ETF, IBIT. The fund's sponsor fee is set at 0.65%.
title: BlackRock Files 8-A for Yield-Bearing Bitcoin ETF

details: JPMorgan analysts report an accelerated retreat from the 'debasement trade' for Bitcoin in recent weeks. They suggest a positive second half for the crypto market hinges on digital asset treasury companies providing clearer guidance on dividend payments and the approval of the Clarity Act, an outcome they assess as having less than a 50% probability.
title: JPMorgan: Bitcoin's 'Debasement Trade' Retreat Accelerates

details: Citigroup is rolling out a regulated blockchain-based platform designed for wealthy and institutional clients to trade tokenized shares of private companies. Initially available to non-U.S. investors, the system utilizes tokenized depositary receipts, with Citi serving as both the issuer and custodian. This move aims to enhance efficiency in private markets.
title: Citi to Launch Blockchain Platform for Tokenized Private Shares

details: The launch of the highly anticipated SpaceX IPO today has attracted substantial institutional and retail capital. Crypto investors are expressing concerns that this major liquidity event could temporarily divert capital away from cryptocurrency markets, potentially impacting crypto asset valuations and overall market liquidity.
title: SpaceX IPO Raises Concerns of Crypto Capital Drain

details: A Reuters investigation revealed that the Trump family has earned at least $2.3 billion from four cryptocurrency projects since Donald Trump assumed office. Concurrently, over one million investors in these same projects have collectively experienced losses amounting to approximately $2.3 billion.
title: Reuters: Trump Family Earned Billions from Crypto, Investors Lost Similar Amounts

details: Bitcoin's price has advanced by 2.4% over the past 24 hours, trading around $62,800, with its dominance rate increasing to 59%. In contrast, major altcoins such as Ethereum and Solana are currently trading below their 200-week moving averages, indicating a strengthening bearish momentum for these assets.
title: Bitcoin Advances While Ethereum, Solana Struggle Below Key Technical Levels

details: An emerging AI price war between OpenAI and Anthropic, fueled by OpenAI's plans to reduce developer fees and Anthropic's recent profitability, is anticipated to significantly lower the costs associated with AI for crypto and Web3 projects. This competitive dynamic could foster innovation and development within the decentralized space.
title: OpenAI & Anthropic AI Price War Could Impact Crypto & Web3 Costs

details: Nakamoto, a Bitcoin treasury company, has sold approximately 600 BTC and related derivatives. The proceeds from this sale are being utilized to reduce debt, lower financing costs, and extend the maturity of a significant loan facility. This strategic move underscores a broader trend among Bitcoin treasury companies to prioritize balance sheet strength.
title: Bitcoin Treasury Firm Nakamoto Sells BTC to Reduce Debt
